title: tephrosia rhodesica var. evansii
intro: Tephrosia rhodesica var. evansii, commonly known as the Rhodesian tephrosia, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin ailments, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain and immune-related disorders. Bioactive constituents present in Tephrosia rhodesica var. evansii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
